from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial metric record extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in this document (e.g., full legal name)")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the financial line item (e.g., 'Credit Impairment Loss')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of the metric")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period mentioned in the text")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
